notes.title: Starglades
notes.notes:
The first version of Starglades: Episode 1 is out! I hope you enjoy what's there so far, the plan is to release more episodes after the first Sanitize installment.

Starglades is a 2.5D platformer with RPG elements and companion combat. The player must learn new abilities to defend innocent domains from deletion, traveling through dark and whimsical landscapes, solving puzzles, and overcoming hostile obstacles to reach this goal.

The aesthetic and story of Starglades is influenced by early generations of webcomics, flash games, RPG concepts, and is planned to be suitable for all ages.

Thank you everyone for the kind support throughout development. More to come!
